displayOrder.name: quiet-companionship
displayOrder.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic, production-quality redesign of the Chinese RunBuoy website desktop hero, target 1600 x 960 (same approximately 1.66:1 aspect as reference homepage). One complete hero screenshot, not a moodboard. Current date 2026-10-05, no added dates required.
Reference 1 mascot-banner.png: exact mascot identity reference, red and white friendly glossy 3D buoy with red ball antenna, black oval eyes, smile and pink cheeks, blue scalloped water base. Preserve identity and material. Reference 2 current-homepage.png: existing website brand, typography, approved copy, true iPhone task UI and black Live Activity. Redesign composition but preserve product truth.
Users are developers running long Mac/Linux tasks who want to glance at progress on iPhone. Hero should make this clear and feel friendly, calm, refined. White and extremely pale periwinkle/ice-blue surface, blue headline accent, blue-to-purple primary CTA, dark navy SF/PingFang-like Chinese sans serif. Generous whitespace, no invented cards/features, no decorative badges. Not an entire screen inside a rounded card. A slim top navigation with RunBuoy mascot logo and wordmark on left; right text links 下载 App / 快速开始 / 使用文档 / 简体中文.
Approved copy verbatim: small eyebrow “MAC / LINUX → IPHONE”; large headline “扫一眼，” and “掌握任务的进展。”; body “安装交给 Agent，状态带到 iPhone。” then “阶段、结果随手看，重要消息随身收。”; CTA “App Store 下载” and secondary “连接我的电脑”; small note “iOS 18 及以上 · Mac / Linux · 新版预览，任务为示例数据”. Preserve text accurately, no additional slogans. iPhone screen retains reference hierarchy with “正在运行”, training task and blue progress bars, and restrained small Live Activity retaining “大模型微调 · 第 8 轮” and “72%”. Phone bezel allowed since this is a marketing webpage, not mobile app screen. Make graphic and UI comfortably fit canvas, no clipped headline or device. Imagery intentional, light soft shadows, avoid generic SaaS card grids.
Art direction: Quiet companionship. Split composition: left 47% carries generous left-aligned headline, body and two actions, right 53% is a tightly art-directed hero scene. A large readable almost-upright iPhone stands toward the right edge. The exact buoy mascot sits front-left of the phone at roughly half phone height, smiling toward the visitor. Pale blue water ripples softly connect the mascot and phone into one shared composition, dissolving into white, no flooded room. Mascot never covers the main task information. Compact black Live Activity floats across the lower phone area, offset away from mascot face. Headline blue second line, confident but not oversized. Keep a clear gap between copy and art.

A smaller but clearly readable upright iPhone around 340px tall sits slightly behind and to the outer right of the mascot, never masking face; it is secondary proof, not the tallest element.
